requirements.text: SCHEMA and ensureColumn add nullable tool_call_id, project_root, subagent_role to tool_calls and nullable project_root, subagent_role to inference_calls; keep preexisting rows and columns.

telemetryProjectRoot(cwd) uses the parent of git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir in cwd, including worktrees; non-git cwd falls back to findProjectRoot(cwd). Store root from ctx.cwd at agent_start and write it to both row types.
Write row.toolCallId to tool_calls.tool_call_id and capture PI_BUILD_SUBAGENT_ROLE at telemetry state creation, writing the captured role on every tool and inference row or null when unset.
explainSpawnEnv(base=process.env,role='explain') sets PI_BUILD_SUBAGENT_ROLE; recap calls it with 'recap'.
Preserve existing telemetry and mapCommand behaviour for legacy rows and calls without extra databases; historical backfill and adapter attribution rules stay unchanged.
childEnv(base,role,telemetryDb) returns a new environment preserving base with PI_BUILD_PIPELINE=1, PI_BUILD_SUBAGENT_ROLE=role and PI_BUILD_TELEMETRY_DB=telemetryDb.
pipelineRunRoot(settings,home) uses pipeline.runRoot or defaults to <home>/var/pipeline-runs.
pipelineTelemetryDbs(root) recursively returns sorted telemetry.db and *-telemetry.db files, [] for absent root.
Planner spawn uses planner role and configured pipelineRunRoot; planner telemetry is in its run directory.
Each task spawn uses editor role and its task database; integration spawn uses integration role and its integration database.

mapCommand accepts extraTelemetry?: string[] and appends one --telemetry per path after the main telemetry; extension includes all databases from pipelineTelemetryDbs(pipelineRunRoot(settings,homedir())).
Export shouldRunMap(env), false for PI_BUILD_PIPELINE=1, and suppress map builds inside pipeline children.
markImplemented(indexText,specText,id,by) changes only the spec header Status and matching index Status and Implemented by; missing index row throws.
After final grade passes, pipeline hand-off applies markImplemented with 'pi pipeline' to branch spec and index; failed grades never mark implemented.
Interactive agent instruction requires successful final acceptance to update spec header and docs/specs/index.md with Implemented by.
Add method entity kind and member_of relation kind to IR constants/schema; document meanings in tools/map/README.md.
TypeScript captures every named function_declaration at any depth, exported or not, and each const/let declarator valued by arrow function or function expression at any depth.
TypeScript captures every class-body method_definition including getters and setters as kind method.
Python captures function_definition at any depth, kind method only when its parent scope is a class, otherwise function.
Named nested functions have member_of to enclosing function; methods have member_of to class; retain existing defines relations and qualified ids.
Anonymous callbacks are not entities and accesses inside them attribute to the innermost named scope.

Every erd.json entity has layer data or code: data for table,file_store,config,dataclass,pydantic,typeddict,enum,global and class/interface/type with fields; code otherwise; class with fields and methods remains in both page views.
Every erd.json entity has boolean test, true for files under tests/ or named test_*.py,*_test.py,conftest.py,*.test.ts,*.test.tsx,*.spec.ts,*.spec.tsx.
Regenerate both TypeScript and Python conformance goldens; add records only and preserve all existing entities, relations and accesses.
Keep scripts/report.sql snapshot totals and existing treemap and call graph views unchanged; run stage and integrated verification without editing protected tests or telemetry snapshot.
_explain_links keeps first-line marker precedence; otherwise links strictly named YYYY-MM-DD-turn-<id>.md by filename, not known.md or unrelated files.
Tab order and ids: Treemap treemap/view-treemap, Call graph callgraph/view-callgraph, Data data/view-data, Code code/view-code; treemap default; keys 1–4 select tabs.
Data shows data-layer entities and fields, has_field_of and fk relations, plus smaller function/method nodes with read/write access and corresponding edges.
Code groups code-layer entities by module and member_of ownership, repeats data owners of code members, and lists owner's event subscriptions.
Code test entities hidden by default behind toggle; retain modules-and-imports toggle; preserve treemap and call graph.
This repository's .map/project.toml excludes docs/specs/*.reference/** and tests/fixtures/** but not live spec tests or source.
test_performance warms environment once untimed, then measures cold and warm runs in a fresh environment.
Regenerate tools/map/fixtures/sample-index.html from the final snapshot/build.

tasks.brief: Stage 1. Edit only lib/telemetry.ts. Read §6.1 and the existing SCHEMA, ensureColumn, attachTelemetry agent_start, recordToolCall, recordInference, state creation, explainSpawnEnv and lib/scaffold.ts findProjectRoot. Implement nullable migrations and new-row attribution without changing old rows, write toolCallId and captured role; export telemetryProjectRoot(cwd), use git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir with cwd, parent of returned path; fallback findProjectRoot(cwd). Extend explainSpawnEnv(base=process.env, role='explain') to label child. Do not change adapter, snapshot, spec tests, report.sql or other files. Check V1 and existing telemetry tests.

Stage 1. Edit only extensions/recap.ts: pass 'recap' as second argument to lib/telemetry.ts explainSpawnEnv for recap child; preserve explain default and other env behaviour. Read §6.1, explainSpawnEnv and existing recap spawn. Do not edit telemetry or spec tests.

Stage 1. Edit only lib/pipeline.ts. Read SPEC-0014 §6.1, lib/pipeline.ts and docs/specs/SPEC-0014-complete-the-codebase-map.tests/pipeline-roles.test.ts; do not edit other files, tests, plan, or docs. Add exported childEnv(base: Record<string,string|undefined>, role: 'planner'|'editor'|'integration', telemetryDb: string): Record<string,string|undefined> returning a NEW {...base, PI_BUILD_PIPELINE:'1', PI_BUILD_SUBAGENT_ROLE:role, PI_BUILD_TELEMETRY_DB:telemetryDb}; accept NodeJS.ProcessEnv as base. Export pipelineRunRoot(settings: unknown, home: string): string; read settings.pipeline.runRoot if nonempty string, otherwise join(home,'var/pipeline-runs'). Export pipelineTelemetryDbs(root:string):string[]; recursively traverse directories and include only regular files named telemetry.db or ending -telemetry.db, sorted full paths; absent root -> []; preserve testCommands/preflight. No open design decision or changes to call sites.

Stage 1. Edit only lib/specs.ts. Read SPEC-0014 §6.1, lib/specs.ts, docs/specs/index.md format and docs/specs/SPEC-0014-complete-the-codebase-map.tests/writeback.test.ts. Do not edit other files, plan, indexes, or tests. Export markImplemented(indexText:string,specText:string,id:string,by:string):{index:string;spec:string}; find exactly one index table row by the four-digit ID cell (not a substring or title), change only Status to 'implemented' and Implemented by to 'by', preserving delimiters, whitespace, other rows and text; throw an error containing id if no row. In spec change only the header table's Status value to 'implemented', not body prose; preserve all other text. Existing listSpecs/resolveSpec/specPaths unchanged.

Stage 1. Edit only bin/pi-implement. Read §6.1, pipeline.ts childEnv/pipelineRunRoot, specs.ts markImplemented, current planner spawn, hand-off and branch commits. Use configured pipelineRunRoot(settings,os.homedir()) for base and childEnv(process.env,'planner',path.join(dir,'planner.db')) for planner and repair sessions. After final passing grade and merge, mark spec and docs/specs/index.md with markImplemented(...,'pi pipeline') on branch and commit alongside run record; never mark on failure. Preserve protected files and run command behaviour. Do not edit pipeline.ts, specs.ts, spec tests or runner.

Stage 1. Edit only scripts/run-plan.mjs. Read §6.1, pipeline.ts childEnv, existing task and integration spawn paths. Use childEnv(process.env,'editor',task DB) in each task spawn, childEnv(process.env,'integration',integration DB) for integration spawn, retaining isolation and all current gate/grade logic. Do not edit other files or protected tests.

Stage 1. Edit only extensions/map.ts. Read §6.1, lib/pipeline.ts, mapCommand and tests/map-shim.test.ts. Extend mapCommand input with extraTelemetry?:string[]; append each --telemetry path after the original, preserve identical no-extra output. Export shouldRunMap(env: Record<string,string|undefined>):boolean, false iff PI_BUILD_PIPELINE==='1'. Use pipelineTelemetryDbs(pipelineRunRoot(settings,homedir())) when building; do not run automatic or manual map build in a pipeline child. Keep existing single-flight and agent_end behaviour outside pipeline. Do not add an extension or edit other files.

Stage 1. Edit only agent/AGENTS.md: add the spec's exact interactive-session acceptance write-back instruction for spec header and /docs/specs/index.md, with Implemented by. Read §6.1 and existing agent instructions. No other edits.

Stage 2. Edit only tools/map/map_build/ir.py. Read SPEC-0014 §6.2, ir.py ENTITY_KINDS and RELATION_KINDS/schema, tools/map/tests/test_core.py; do not change schema version, any dataclass, old kinds, other files, golden data or tests. Add string 'method' to ENTITY_KINDS and 'member_of' to RELATION_KINDS; schema generation must accept new Entity(kind='method') and Relation(kind='member_of') and every existing kind without changing record structure. No design decisions or call-site edits.

Stage 2. Edit only TypeScript structure.scm. Read §6.2, structure query, queries.py Runner and typescript/module.py SPEC. Capture named function_declaration at all depths (exported and local), const/let variable_declarator valued by arrow/function_expression at all depths, and class-body method_definition/get/set as @entity.method. Do not capture anonymous callbacks as entities; avoid duplicating export captures. Preserve all old fields/relations and access attribution. Owner relation wiring is in T13, not this file; do not edit runner, tests or golden.

Stage 2. Edit only Python structure.scm. Read §6.2, python/module.py and queries.py. Capture every function_definition including decorated, class-body and nested definitions, without duplicate records; methods need kind method when immediate enclosing named scope is class; if query alone cannot distinguish parent scope, coordinate runner T13 using existing @entity.* capture rather than altering other files. Preserve class and field captures and access attribution. Do not edit tests or goldens.

Stage 2. Edit only queries.py, after TS and Python query changes. Read §6.2, Runner.owner/qualname/actor and both structure.scm files. Emit member_of relation from nested named functions to their enclosing named function and from methods to owning class, while preserving existing defines records and ids; infer Python direct class-parent function kind method versus function elsewhere if necessary. Anonymous callbacks remain no Entity; accesses attribute to nearest named scope. Do not edit extraction modules, tests or goldens.

Stage 2. Edit only erd.py. Read §6.2, fields_by filtering and build_erd result; retain existing entities, relations and accesses. Add layer to every emitted entity with explicit data-kind list plus class/interface/type iff fields nonempty; all else code. Add boolean test based on tests/ path component or enumerated Python/TS name patterns. Ensure method ownership visibility even when no fields; preserve aggregation and stats semantics. Do not edit other files or tests.

Stage 2. Edit only tools/map/README.md. Read §6.2 and existing IR vocabulary description. Document method entity and member_of relation including direction (member to owner), qualified identifiers and distinction from defines. No other edits.

Stage 2. Regenerate only TypeScript structure conformance golden from the completed extractor. Read §6.2 and conformance/test_conformance.py; preserve all existing JSONL records byte-equivalent as records, append only new valid entities and relations (stable golden ordering according to conformance generator). Never edit test fixtures, tests or Python golden. Compare prior vs regenerated sets explicitly.

Stage 2. Regenerate only Python structure conformance golden from completed extractor. Read §6.2 and conformance/test_conformance.py; preserve existing JSONL records as records and add only newly captured records. Do not edit fixture sample, tests or TypeScript golden. Compare old and new record sets.

Stage 3. Edit only tools/map/map_build/build.py. Read SPEC-0014 §6.3, current _EXPLAIN_MARKER and _explain_links, and docs/specs/SPEC-0014-complete-the-codebase-map.tests/test_map_views.py walkthrough test. Do not edit any other file, tests or telemetry adapter. _explain_links(repo:Path,explain_dir:str)->dict[str,list[str]] scans *.md in sorted order; if first line matches existing <!-- turn: <id> --> regex, use that id exclusively. Otherwise accept only filename <YYYY-MM-DD>-turn-<id>.md, extract nonempty id after turn- and before .md; reject known.md and unrelated names. Preserve relative POSIX links, unreadable-file handling and original marker precedence.

Stage 3. Edit only render/template.html. Read §6.3 and current markup plus app.js dependencies. Replace erd tab/panel with Data and Code tabs, ordered ids and data-tab values per spec; supply two view panels/canvases/controls and test toggle off by default; retain modules-and-imports toggle and styles for both views. Preserve treemap and callgraph markup. Coordinate element ids with T19 app.js; do not edit JS, tests or fixture.

Stage 3. Edit only render/app.js after T18. Read §6.3, template.html controls and erd.json layer/test/relations/access schema. Implement 4 tabs and keyboard 1–4, default treemap; Data field cards with has_field_of/fk and smaller function/method read/write nodes/edges; Code groups module declarations and member_of, includes data owner with code members, displays owner's subscribe events, toggle hides test code initially; retain modules/imports toggle. Do not change treemap or callgraph, other files or tests.

Stage 3. Edit only .map/project.toml. Read SPEC-0014 §6.3, current exclude array, map_build/walk.py any_match and docs/specs/SPEC-0014-complete-the-codebase-map.tests/test_map_views.py exclusion test. Add exactly the two patterns 'docs/specs/*.reference/**' and 'tests/fixtures/**' to exclude without removing previous patterns or hiding docs/specs/*.tests/**, source or the live spec. Do not edit anything else, protected tests, or fixtures.

Stage 3. Edit only tools/map/tests/test_snapshot.py test_performance. Read §6.3 and existing test: run build once untimed to warm Python/uv/environment startup with disposable output, then time a cold build with no previous map cache and a warm build on the same output; keep existing cold/warm bounds, cache assertion and meaningful tool measurements. Do not edit the spec's protected .tests/, fixtures or other tests.

Stage 3 last artifact. Regenerate only tools/map/fixtures/sample-index.html from the updated snapshot/map build at final commit, with Data and Code tabs and full inlined assets; read §6.3 and snapshot generation procedure. Do not alter protected telemetry.db, tests, map source, or treemap/callgraph semantics. Check V9–V14 and preserved snapshot report totals in final integration; record execution in run record, not this file.
